clips.title: The story
paras: In the cold foothills of Dun Morogh, Senir Whitebeard sends word of the Frostmane trolls to Ironforge. His report carries findings gathered under King Magni Bronzebeard’s directive for Senator Barin Redstone.

Senir Whitebeard’s report gathers mountaineer observations from scouting against Frostmane trolls in Dun Morogh’s crags. Stationed in the cold foothills, Senir includes his brother Grelin’s account of Coldridge Valley, where Grelin acted under King Magni Bronzebeard’s sanction. Senir sends the findings to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge’s High Seat and advises couriers to leave out how much outside help he needed to compile them.
